scope: Gemini research intake for certified organic frozen minced beef and chicken in EU wholesale/industrial supply
screening_decision: All new records remain unverified until product-level frozen minced format, several-pallet/MOQ evidence and organic certificate/operator verification are available.
priority_outreach: Good Herdsmen Ltd / ABP Food Group (IE)
Vion Food Group / De Groene Weg (NL)
quality_findings: Several report rows are labelled verified without public proof of an exact frozen minced block SKU and several-pallet terms.
The reports are internally inconsistent about chicken verification.
The cited Tamminen 2 kg beef page is a regular Rotukarja product and does not prove organic beef; it was not imported as an organic candidate.
Retail prices, conventional commodity benchmarks and estimated wholesale ranges were excluded from price statistics.
Distributors and brokers are retained as secondary leads and are not mixed with producer counts.
next_verification_fields: Block, bulk or pallet pack format
Minimum order quantity or several-pallet evidence
Organic control body and operator/certificate number with lookup URL
Direct wholesale quote in EUR/kg or EUR/tonne
